description: Static structural contract for the rdx-code-review R2 wrapper. The wrapper must (a) be selected via the CR menu code override, (b) invoke bmad-code-review as a child skill, (c) invoke rdx-judgment AFTER the child (so the Rule Auditor layer can influence the final verdict), (d) emit a unified report with both layers, (e) not recurse, (f) carry the soft-gate disclaimer.
